name: OpenStreetMap

meta.description: Allows models to query OpenStreetMap for information and nearby points of interest.

specs.name: find_address_for_coordinates
specs.description: Resolves GPS coordinates to a specific address or place.

latitude.description: The latitude portion of the GPS coordinate.

longitude.description: The longitude portion of the GPS coordinate.

specs.name: find_eateries_and_drinking_by_category_near_place
specs.description:
Finds places to eat or drink on OpenStreetMap near a given place or address.
For setting, specify if the place is an urban area, a suburb, or a rural location.
If it is unclear what category the user wants, ask for clarification.

place.description: The name of a place, an address, or GPS coordinates. City and country must be specified, if known.

category.description: Category of eateries to search for.

setting.description: Urban-ness of the requested location. Controls search radius.

specs.name: find_education_by_category_near_place
specs.description:
Find education institutions and resources on OpenStreetMap.
For setting, specify if the place is an urban area, a suburb, or a rural location.
Note: category "schools" searches only for primary and secondary schools, NOT universities or colleges.

place.description: The name of a place, an address, or GPS coordinates. City and country must be specified, if known.

category.description: Category of education to search for.

setting.description: Urban-ness of the requested location. Controls search radius.

specs.name: find_fuel_or_charging_by_category_near_place
specs.description:
Finds gas stations, petrol stations, fuel stations, or EV fast chargers near a given place or address.
For setting, specify if the place is an urban area, a suburb, or a rural location.
Does not find slow (regular) EV chargers. EV fast charger note: 'chademo3' is not the same as 'chademo'.
'chademo3' is also known as 'chaoji'.j

place.description: The name of a place, an address, or GPS coordinates. City and country must be specified, if known.

category.description: Category to search for: either fossil fuels or EV fast chargers.

fuel_type.description: Type of fossil fuel to search for.

ev_charger_type.description: Type of EV charger to search for.

setting.description: Urban-ness of the requested location. Controls search radius.

specs.name: find_healthcare_by_category_near_place
specs.description:
Find healthcare, doctors, dentists, hospitals, and pharmacies on OpenStreetMap.
For setting, specify if the place is an urban area, a suburb, or a rural location.
If it is unclear what category the user wants, ask for clarification.

place.description: The name of a place, an address, or GPS coordinates. City and country must be specified, if known.

category.description: Category of healthcare to search for.

setting.description: Urban-ness of the requested location. Controls search radius.

specs.name: find_other_things_near_place
specs.description:
Find shops and other places not covered by a specific
category available in the other functions. Use this if the
user is asking for a type of store or place that other
functions do not support. For setting, specify if the place is
an urban area, a suburb, or a rural location.

place.description: The name of a place, an address, or GPS coordinates. City and country must be specified, if known.

setting.description: Urban-ness of the requested location. Controls search radius.

category.description: The category of place, shop, etc to look up.

specs.name: find_place_of_worship_near_place
specs.description:
Finds places of worship (churches, mosques, temples, etc) on OpenStreetMap near a
given place or address. For setting, specify if the place is an urban area,
a suburb, or a rural location. If searching for a denomination, the denomination must be part of the
given religion. If NOT searching for any specific denomination, use the special 'any_denomination'
value. If a religion is specified as not common in the requested area, the search radius
will be greatly increased. A religion is common in the requested area if it traditionally has
a lot of adherents or a visible social presence in the area.

place.description: The name of a place, an address, or GPS coordinates. City and country must be specified, if known.

religion.description: Narrow the search to a particular religion. Use "any_religion" to search for all places of worship.

denomination.description: Narrow search to denomination of particular religion. Denomination must match religion.

is_common_for_area.description: Whether or not the religion or denomination is common in the requested area.

setting.description: Urban-ness of the requested location. Controls search radius.

specs.name: find_recreation_by_category_near_place
specs.description:
Finds recreation facilities of a specific type on OpenStreetMap near a given place or address.
For setting, specify if the place is an urban area, a suburb, or a rural location.
Note: amusement category can be arcades, theme parks, and similar.

place.description: The name of a place, an address, or GPS coordinates. City and country must be specified, if known.

category.description: Category of recreation to search for.

setting.description: Urban-ness of the requested location. Controls search radius.

specs.name: find_specific_named_business_or_landmark_near_coordinates
specs.description:
Finds specifically named stores, businesses, or landmarks near the given
GPS coordinates. This can be used for general or specific things,
like 'gas station' or 'grocery store', or the name of a specific
chain (like 'Wal-Mart' or 'Albert Heijn'). This function is intended
for finding specific chains or businesses near the given coordinates.
Use this if the user asks about businesses or places nearby.

store_or_business_name.description: Name of store or business to look for.

latitude.description: The latitude portion of the GPS coordinate.

longitude.description: The longitude portion of the GPS coordinate.

specs.name: find_specific_place
specs.description:
Looks up details on OpenStreetMap of a specific address, landmark,
place, named building, or location. Used for when the user asks where
a specific unique entity (like a specific museum, or church, or shopping
center) is.

address_or_place.description: The address or place to look up.

specs.name: find_stores_by_category_near_place
specs.description:
Finds stores of a specific type on OpenStreetMap near a given place or address.
For setting, specify if the place is an urban area, a suburb, or a rural location.

place.description: The name of a place, an address, or GPS coordinates. City and country must be specified, if known.

category.description: Category of store to search for.

setting.description: Urban-ness of the requested location. Controls search radius.

specs.name: find_travel_info_by_category_near_place
specs.description:
Find tourist attractions, accommodation, public transport, bike rentals, or car rentals on OpenStreetMap.
For setting, specify if the place is an urban area, a suburb, or a rural location.
If it is unclear what category the user wants, ask for clarification.

place.description: The name of a place, an address, or GPS coordinates. City and country must be specified, if known.

category.description: Category of travel info to search for.

setting.description: Urban-ness of the requested location. Controls search radius.

specs.name: navigate_between_places
specs.description: Retrieve a navigation route and associated information between two places.

start_address_or_place.description: The address, place, or coordinates to start from.

destination_address_or_place.description: The destination address, place, or coordinates to go.

specs.name: resolve_coordinates
specs.description:
Resolves GPS coordinates to a human-readable location such
as an address or place name. Use this to convert GPS
coordinates before searching if you need to figure out urban,
suburban, or rural setting.

latitude.description: The latitude portion of the GPS coordinate.

longitude.description: The longitude portion of the GPS coordinate.

specs.name: show_map
specs.description:
Shows a map for search results. Takes a list of Points of Interest that
were returned in a previous search function call. You **must** call another
function first to get information required for this function! Make sure to
pass all necessary results into this function! When specifying descriptions,
make sure they are short and useful, mentioning unique or important info
about each result. **After calling this function, only acknowledge that the
map is generated. It will be rendered by the client!**

results.description: Point of Interest (POI) results from a previous function call.

items.description: Represents a Point of Interest found during map search.

name.description: Name of the Point of Interest.

address.description: Address of the Point of Interest.

description.description: Useful one sentence description of the Point of Interest, containing important or unique information. Do not put distance here.

distance.description: Distance in km or miles from the search location.

lat.description: Latitude of the Point of Interest.

lon.description: Longitude of the Point of Interest.

osm_id.description: OpenStreetMap ID of the Point of Interest.

osm_type.description: OpenStreetMap entity type of the Point of Interest.
